claim.claim_boundary: X-15-scaled staged reduced-order boost/coast/release/glide witness with parent translation and explicit passive spent-booster deployment; no controlled terminal handoff, native X-15 batch provider, or physical-effector qualification is claimed.
nonclaims: No controlled terminal approach or energy-managed handoff is claimed.
No physical stabilator, rudder, throttle, RCS, or control-surface allocation is claimed.
The pseudo-6DOF attitude channels are a named response bridge, not source-derived moments.
claim.proves: The reduced staged X-15 witness preserves the declared boost, cutoff, release, glide, and impact event ordering.

source.claim_boundary: X-15-scaled staged reachability surrogate; not a native X-15 rigid-body batch provider

fidelity_boundary.rigid_body_6dof: reduced parent and native rigid-body child

source.integration_note: The source mission declares 9000 kg booster propellant but its 20 s, 100 kg/s powered segment consumes 2000 kg; the reduced-order mass closure models the consumed amount and records the discrepancy.
